# Luxor

> India's premier writing instruments and stationery manufacturing company, producing premium pens, markers, and notebooks under iconic global brands.

Luxor is a leading manufacturer of writing instruments and stationery products in India, known for producing premium brands like Parker and Waterman. The company combines manufacturing expertise with a diverse product portfolio serving both domestic and international markets.
